# Atom Rosales

Spatial data science, GIS, and operational analytics for public health mosquito control.

I build geospatial workflows, dashboards, analysis notebooks, and field-to-decision systems for vector surveillance, UAS operations, treatment planning, and integrated mosquito management.

::: {.home-links}
[Projects](projects/index.qmd)
[CV](cv.qmd)
:::

:::

::: {.home-notes}

**Focus areas**

- Vector surveillance and mosquito control operations
- GIS, dashboards, and field data systems
- UAS, LiDAR, and remote sensing workflows
- Reproducible spatial analysis for public health decision support

:::

## Current focus

I am interested in geospatial decision-support systems that connect field surveillance, environmental conditions, remote sensing, and treatment operations into reproducible workflows for integrated pest management.
